detail.longDescription: Globe Business earns 13 Stevie awards for programs advancing practical enterprise digital transformation Globe Business recorded one of its strongest showings at the Stevie Awards with 13 wins, including nine Gold awards. The international honors recognize its work across cybersecurity, digital innovation, AI adoption, and thought leadership, further establishing the brand as a trusted ICT and connectivity provider for Philippine enterprises. The wins reflect how Globe Business continues to build platforms that guide organizations toward intelligent transformation. Its programs span immersive experiences, digital tools, industry events, and executive-led conversations that tackle practical challenges facing Philippine enterprises today. “Enterprise leaders are looking for clarity above everything else,” said Glenn Estrella, Globe Business Vice President. “Before committing capital to new architectures, organizations want to understand how a solution fits into their daily workflows, how it protects business continuity, and how their teams can run it confidently. These recognitions validate our commitment to orchestrating intelligence across connectivity, cloud, and security, giving decision-makers practical, low-risk ways to test, learn, and deploy.” A major share of the Gold honors recognized environments built for risk-free experimentation, where corporate teams test systems prior to procurement. In cybersecurity, Globe Business Cyberheist: Preventing Threats through Gamified Cyber-Resilience won Gold for Brand Experience of the Year in Business-to-Business by placing IT and executive leadership into simulated incident response scenarios to evaluate operational resilience safely. Infrastructure assessment received similar recognition through Globe Business Digitest, named Branded Utility of the Year for giving enterprises an automated diagnostic tool to evaluate their network readiness. This practical approach also earned top honors across cloud and artificial intelligence applications. Mindhive: A Sandboxing Event Series for Digital Innovators earned Gold for Event Series by hosting controlled sandboxes where customers stress-test multi-cloud configurations without commercial risk. In artificial intelligence, Agent of Change: The Google Agentspace Experience captured two Gold awards across the Tech Event and AI-Powered Event categories, demonstrating concrete use cases for automated workflows and data indexing in front-line customer operations. Executive dialogue formed the second pillar of recognized programs, translating technical concepts into strategic business discussions. Its flagship conference, G Summit 2025: Disrupt, earned two Gold awards for Conferences & Meetings and Thought Leadership Brand Experience. The platform Technically Speaking collected two additional Golds across the Business Podcast and Events & Webcasts categories, the podcast gives decision-makers an ongoing forum to examine the latest in enterprise technology in accessible terms. Globe Business also secured two Silver awards for precision customer engagement models. The Globe Business Omni-Channel ABM Ecosystem uses account-based intelligence to align solutions with the operational priorities of specific enterprise accounts rather than broad messaging. Concurrently, the Breakthrough Masterclass Webinar Series delivered actionable operational playbooks to help growing small businesses navigate the ever-evolving digital landscape with tactical operational guidance on complex regulatory requirements, expanding to global marketplace, and utilizing AI in daily workflows. Completing the honors, to meet business leaders where they evaluate workplace challenges daily, Globe Business established an executive-led communications series on LinkedIn which earned two Bronze awards. For Globe Business, these recognitions reinforce a clear direction for its enterprise communications. Its events, content platforms, and executive voices are creating spaces where business leaders can engage with the technologies reshaping their industries and understand how these developments translate into actual business decisions. As organizations navigate AI, cybersecurity, connectivity, cloud, and digital transformation, the conversations around these technologies are becoming just as important as the technologies themselves. In navigating this landscape, partnering with a trusted ICT and connectivity provider makes all the difference. Globe Business continues to bring those conversations closer to the realities of Philippine businesses, connecting technical developments with questions of growth, innovation, resilience, and leadership. To learn more about the award-winning programs of Globe Business, visit www.globe.com.ph/business . #ai #artificialIntelligence #business #chatgpt #Technology
